title: Oh No! The Snowman Has No Nose! ⛄ 10 Happy Songs with Baby Jimmy & Baby Ava | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy's snowman has no nose! ⛄ Grab your magic crayon and sing 10 happy learning songs with Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava – snowy winter fun, letters, colors, animals and good habits in over 5 minutes of sing-along fun for toddlers and preschoolers.

🎬 What happens in this video:
⛄ Jimmy's snowman needs a carrot nose – what's missing?
🧤 Brrr! Ava puts on her jacket, hat and mittens
🧊 Ava's duck is stuck in the ice – the warm sun melts it free!
🐱 C is for cat, C is for cake – learn the letter C
🍎 Red apple, yellow banana, green pear – sing the colors
🎈 Up goes the balloon, down rolls the ball!
🐘 Toot like an elephant, roar like a lion at the zoo
🚸 Stop, look, hold hands – crossing the street safely
🧁 A birthday cupcake and a card for Daddy
🌙 Book, dino, blanket – Jimmy's bedtime routine

📚 Kids learn: what's missing (snowman: eyes, smile, nose) • dressing for cold weather (jacket, hat, mittens) • little science: ice melts in the warm sun • the letter C (cat, cake) • colors (red, yellow, green) • opposites: up and down • zoo animal sounds • road safety: stop, look, hold hands • love for family • a calm bedtime routine

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun nursery rhyme compilation for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 1–5) with Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava: winter songs, learning songs about letters, colors, opposites and animals, plus good-habit songs for safety, family and bedtime. Sing, clap and learn along!

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Winter songs for kids • Learning songs for toddlers • Good habits for kids • Learn English for kids • Preschool learning • Sing-along songs
